title: Security Center
items: Added the Security Center with Owner, Extra Owner and Trusted Admin tiers, a tier lock that is on by default, and a global whitelist with a scope for each system
Added security setup, one command that scans your server and configures protection, plus more than 220 security settings, four presets, and settings export and import
Added web verification with a link-based captcha and optional VPN and alt account detection, plus join checks for impersonators and returning banned members
Added AutoMod warning ladders, Discord's native AutoMod rules and webhook protection
Added Booster Perks: tier roles by boosts, and custom booster roles with settings for name, colour, icon, permissions and position
AntiNuke can now restore a server from its latest backup after an attack, and backups include bans and server settings
YouTube alerts now arrive within seconds of a new upload

Added server templates: build a full server from seven ready-made presets, including a Premium dating and social server with verified roles and ticket panels, or save your own server and share it with a code
Added Join to Create voice channels with owner controls, and reaction role panels can now use buttons

title: Web dashboard
items: Added a web dashboard with Discord sign-in and per-server settings
Added search and on or off switches for every module
The dashboard can create and edit ticket panels, giveaways, reaction roles, custom commands and alerts
The dashboard can manage embeds, greetings, leveling rewards and moderation actions
Added an audit log of every change made from the dashboard
Rebuilt the website with a categorized command list, documentation, changelog and legal pages
Tickets now support multiple panels and several staff roles per panel
Added YouTube and Twitch alerts for uploads and streams
Added a dashboard redesign with a sidebar, overview stats and a better phone layout

title: Help and server tools
items: The help menu now hides developer-only categories from regular members
Added command details with usage, aliases and permissions
Added the dashboard command to turn the web dashboard on or off for a server
Added NSFW channels that are limited to a role
Added the supportaccess command to give the Soward team temporary help, which you can end at any time with revokesupport
Added supportstatus to see whether support access is on
Added help lookup by command name, for example help ban
Added a variables list for every message template
Improved error messages across commands

title: Music upgrades
items: Added the lofi command for a constant radio stream
Added custom 24/7 lofi stations you can add for your server
Added move and remove commands for queue items
Added playnext to put a song at the front of the queue
Added a clearfilter command to remove every audio filter
Added Prev, Next, Shuffle and Clear buttons on the queue panel
Added the disconnect command, which also turns off 24/7 and lofi
The Now Playing card refreshes while a song plays
The music source can be set for the whole server

title: Ticket upgrades
items: Added multi-page ticket forms with up to five questions per page
Added ticket forms that ask the opener questions
Added priorities so urgent tickets stand out
Added automatic closing of inactive tickets
Added ticket statistics for staff
Added a transcript channel and transcripts sent to the person who opened the ticket
Added tickets named with a running number, such as ticket-0001
Added unclaim for tickets that need a different staff member
Ticket welcome messages now mention the opener and the staff roles

title: Safer logging
items: Added logs for AntiNuke actions, quarantine and quarantine release
Added logs for AutoMod actions
Added logs for support access being granted or revoked
Added logs for role add and remove commands
Added logs for fake permission changes
Added a separate Security log channel for sensitive events
Log messages now include who did what and when
Event names in logs are easier to read
Added logs for AntiNuke triggers, shown separately from the actions taken

title: Permissions and roles
items: Added fake permissions, a way to let members use commands without giving them Discord permissions
Added fakeperm setup commands and a list of what each member can use
Added automatic cleanup of fake permissions when a role or member is removed
Added role hierarchy checks to every moderation command
Added protection so moderators cannot act on the server owner or on staff above them
Added clearer messages that explain why an action was blocked
Added lockdownall and unlockall for every channel in the server
Added a protected set of sensitive permissions that only the server owner can grant through fake permissions
Added the fakeperm command to check or change a single permission node

title: New message design and lockdown
items: Soward now uses Discord's Components V2 for most messages instead of embeds, giving cleaner cards that read better on phones
Help, info, success and error replies now share one consistent look
Confirmation prompts now use buttons in the same card layout
Added server lockdown to lock every channel at once during an emergency, with channels you can skip and an automatic unlock time
Added automatic lockdown when AntiNuke or AntiRaid detects an attack
Added server backups of roles and channels
Added automatic backups on a schedule
Added backup restore for roles and channels
Added the securitycheck command, a score and a list of problems found in your setup

title: Verification
items: Added member verification with reaction, button, captcha and manual review modes
Added a gate role that is removed once a member verifies
Added a minimum account age before a member can verify
Added a limit on verification attempts
Added a pending timeout for members who never verify
Added staff approve and deny commands for manual review
Added a customizable verification message
Added a verification setup command that posts the panel for you
Added a verification settings view that shows the whole setup

title: AntiRaid
items: Added AntiRaid to detect and stop sudden floods of new members
Added join velocity detection that triggers when too many members join too fast
Added a minimum account age requirement for new members
Added name filters for joining accounts
Added a no-avatar filter
Added raid mode, which you can turn on by hand at any time
Added the option to raise Discord's verification level while raid mode is on
Added a sweep command that finds recent suspicious joins
Added an AntiRaid alert channel and log

title: AntiNuke
items: Added AntiNuke to protect a server from mass deletions and sudden permission changes
Added limits for channel, role, ban, kick and webhook actions, with a short and an hourly window
Added punishments that remove permissions, kick or ban whoever crosses a limit
Added trusted users who are allowed to exceed the limits
Added extra owners who can manage security with the server owner
Added bot blocking so unapproved bots cannot be added
Added quarantine, which removes access from a member until staff release them
Added an incident log that records what happened and what was done
Added an alert channel and owner alerts for security events

title: AutoMod
items: Added AutoMod to remove rule-breaking messages automatically
Added a banned words list with commands to add and remove words
Added invite link blocking with an allowed list
Added domain blocking and an allowed domain list
Added mention spam limits
Added a heat system that tracks repeat offenders and escalates the response
Added exemptions for roles, members and channels
Added a status command that shows every AutoMod setting at a glance
Added content filters for scam links, excessive caps, zalgo text, duplicate messages, emoji spam and attachments

title: Custom commands and premium
items: Added custom commands with text, embed or reaction responses
Added several responses per command and several trigger types
Added custom command cooldowns, restrictions and automatic message deletion
Added custom command groups to keep large collections organized
Added import and export of custom commands between servers
Added Soward Premium with redeemable keys and the claim command
Added higher ticket and embed limits for Premium servers
Added no-prefix mode for Premium users
Added Bot identity so Premium servers can give Soward its own name, avatar, banner and bio

title: Community tools
items: Added giveaways with start, end, cancel and reroll commands
Added giveaway requirements such as required roles and minimum account age
Added bonus entries for chosen roles
Added giveaway entry lists and detailed info for each giveaway
Added polls that members vote on with results shown when the poll ends
Added reaction roles with groups, role limits and several modes
Added locked and gated reaction roles that require another role first
Added an embed builder to create, preview, edit, duplicate and send embeds
Added saved embed templates you can reuse and rename

title: Fun and social
items: Added more than 40 social action commands such as hug, pat, wave and highfive
Added the ship command for a compatibility score between two people
Added truth or dare with separate truth and dare commands
Added the quote maker that turns a message into a styled image
Added quote styles, fonts and colors
Added anime and manga search with trending and random picks
Added anime recommendations by genre and a daily anime pick
Added the AFK command that tells people when you are away
Added afkcheck to see whether a member is AFK and how long they have been away

title: Music
items: Added music playback with play, pause, resume, skip, stop and a live queue
Added loop, shuffle, seek and volume controls
Added a now playing message with controls you can click
Added audio filters including bassboost and nightcore
Added saved playlists that follow you to any server
Added autoplay to keep music going when the queue ends
Added a choice of search source: YouTube, SoundCloud or Spotify
Added a search command that lets you choose from a list of results
Added 24/7 voice mode so the bot can stay in a voice channel

title: Tickets
items: Added support tickets opened from a button on a panel you post
Added ticket claiming so staff can show who is handling a ticket
Added staff roles that can see and manage tickets
Added ticket categories to keep open tickets organized
Added a one-ticket-per-member option and a limit on open tickets
Added ticket transcripts saved when a ticket closes
Added add and remove commands to bring people in or out of a ticket
Added ticket renaming and a subject field
Added a Close button that asks for an optional reason

title: Logging
items: Added server logs split into Moderation, Security, Member Activity, Messages and Server Changes
Added a logging setup command that creates the log channels for you
Added a different log channel for each category
Added per-event switches so a server logs only what it wants
Added message edit and delete logs
Added member join and leave logs
Added server logs for channels and roles that are created or deleted
Added moderation logs that show the moderator, reason and case number
Log entries now use a consistent layout that is easy to scan

title: Leveling
items: Added a leveling system with XP for chatting and time in voice channels, switched on per server
Added rank cards and a server leaderboard
Added level roles that are given automatically when a member reaches a level
Added role stacking so a server can choose between keeping all level roles or only the highest
Added XP multipliers for roles and channels
Added no-XP channels and roles for places where chatting should not count
Added customizable level-up announcements with variables
Added weekly and monthly leaderboard resets
Added setxp and resetxp for staff to correct a member's progress

title: Greetings and autoroles
items: Added welcome and leave messages with a channel, message text and variables for names and counts
Added embed greetings so welcome messages can use your own embed designs
Added a greetings test command to preview a message before members see it
Added the option to send the welcome message by direct message
Added automatic deletion of greeting messages after a set time
Added autoroles that are given to every new member
Added a join role delay so roles can be given a short time after someone joins
Added autorole sync to apply roles to members who joined earlier
Added a separate verify role that is given after a member passes verification

title: Moderation toolkit
items: Added tempban to ban a member for a set time and unban them automatically
Added softban to remove a member's recent messages without a lasting ban
Added purge with filters and purgebots to clear bot messages in one step
Added slowmode, plus lock and unlock for a single channel
Added nickname and role add or remove commands with role hierarchy checks
Added private moderator notes you can view with the notes command
Added case history so every action can be looked up with the cases command
Added modstats to see how active each moderator has been
Added masskick and massban for cleaning up after a problem, with a confirmation step

title: Launch
items: Soward launches with a customizable prefix for every server, set with the prefix command
Added a help menu that groups every command by category and shows details for each one
Added ping, uptime and about commands to check that the bot is healthy
Added userinfo and serverinfo for quick details about members and servers
Added avatar and servericon commands that show images at full size
Added roleinfo and channelinfo for permissions, creation dates and settings
Added ban, unban and kick with a reason recorded for every action
Added mute and unmute using Discord timeouts
Added warn, warnings, delwarn and warnclear to track warnings per member
